author: claude-code
hypothesis: an exact retreat rule and a speed-scaled obstacle guard cut the deaths the executor introduced
change: engage backstop (retreat when hurt/outnumbered/dry), avoidance guard scaled to 0.35 s of travel, do not close on an enemy inside 260 units, plus the target rubric rewrite and relative_distance in the code rule
notes: BUNDLE of three changes, against PROGRAM.md's one-change rule: they went in together while the executor landed, so the row cannot attribute the movement | no gain (-0.0137)

author: claude-code
hypothesis: a code baseline that does not choose fights is a fairer comparison partner and should not be more dangerous
change: engage_backstop defaults to 'Break off and go round' instead of 'Fight while moving'; the safety floor (critically hurt, outnumbered while hurt, nothing loaded) still retreats

author: claude-code
